timing.statement: This amendment was authored before either v2 retrieval method was executed and before any v2 outcome or result artifact existed.

scope.reason: The independently reviewed production admission/current-state helpers changed the exact source commit, and relevance labels had to be removed from retrievable neutral-event fields before any v2 execution.
supersedesOnly: sourceBindings.sourceCommit and the corresponding production implementation/source-tree bindings
neutralStratum.ledger target/support data rules, all derived neutral event hashes, neutral chain head, required-evidence event hashes, and the relevance-map binding
remainsUnchanged: research questions, six neutral tasks, query and current-source bytes, method identities, fixed-k values, output limit, token ceiling, renderer specification, portable estimator, aggregation, missing-evidence rule, and tie rule
BM25 tokenization, fields, formula, rounding, sorting, zero-score, and output-limit controls
all four safety fixtures and their required, forbidden, and conflict-claim bindings
all 24 named negative tests and the development-only claim boundary

qarinah.entrypoint: buildDerivedState(events, workspaceId).index followed by rankContextEvents(index, query, options)

sharedAdmission.policyEligibilitySemantics: The exact pre-score eligibility rules executed by rankContextEvents at sourceCommit: retention expiresAt is null or greater than asOf; event timestamp is strictly less than asOf; temporal validFrom is absent or at most asOf; temporal validUntil is absent, null, or greater than asOf; disclosure is permitted by the exact authorityScopes; and repository is permitted by the exact repositoryIds.
sharedAdmission.currentStateSemantics: After scoring and sorting, apply the same prefer-current rule as rankContextEvents at sourceCommit: exclude superseded events and every member of a supersession cycle unless the frozen query contains that exact event ID.
sharedAdmission.applicationOrder: Apply policy eligibility before BM25 document-frequency, average-length, scoring, and sorting. Apply current-state supersession filtering after sorting and before taking the top 32.
futureEvaluatorMustRecordPerCase: policy-eligible event IDs in event-ledger order
current-state excluded event IDs with reason
equality between the Qarinah and admission-filtered-BM25 policy-eligible sets before scoring
equality of the prefer-current exclusion semantics after ordering
sharedAdmission.implementation: resolveContextAdmission and resolveCurrentContextState exported by src/retrieval.js at sourceCommit
sharedAdmission.policyEligibleOutput: eligibleEventIds and excludedEventIds plus per-event exclusion reasons in ledger order
sharedAdmission.currentStateOutput: eligibleEventIds and excludedEventIds plus supersession exclusions in method order

bm25.queryTerms: deduplicate after tokenization, then sort by JavaScript default string order
bm25.primitiveData: Object.entries(event.data) in stored order, retaining only string, number, and boolean values; reconstruct with Object.fromEntries and serialize with JSON.stringify
bm25.documentLength: number of retained document tokens including duplicates
bm25.averageDocumentLength: arithmetic mean over the exact candidate set after admission, before ranking
bm25.documentFrequency: number of candidate documents containing the query term at least once
bm25.termScore: idf * ((tf * (k1 + 1)) / (tf + k1 * (1 - b + b * (documentLength / Math.max(1, averageDocumentLength))))) * titleBoostForTerm
bm25.titleBoostForTerm: 1.8 when the exact query term occurs in the tokenized title, otherwise 1
bm25.scoreAggregation: sum termScore over the sorted unique query terms
bm25.zeroScoreCandidates: included and ordered by the same timestamp/event-ID tie breaks

algorithm.hashChainRule: in insertion order; previousHash is null for event 1 and the exact prior event hash thereafter
algorithm.requiredEventOrder: base fixture case order; target followed by support array order
algorithm.noiseOrder: noise sequence 0 through 215 after all 24 required events
algorithm.relevanceFieldRule: scenario IDs and target/support roles are absent from every retrievable event data object

allEventBindingsDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(allEventBindings) in ledger order

fullLedgerDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(full event envelopes) in ledger order

requiredEvidenceDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(requiredEvidence) in base case/role order

neutralLedgerBinding.contentBinding: Required title/body bytes remain exactly those in the unchanged base-protocol requiredEvidence entries; titleSha256/bodySha256 above bind those bytes under the relevance-free envelope.

externalRelevanceMapDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(externalRelevanceMap) in base case/role order

relevanceIsolation.storage: evaluation-only map outside every event envelope and derived production index
relevanceIsolation.allowedUse: post-ranking measurement of fixed-k utility and the evidence-complete prefix only
relevanceIsolation.forbiddenUse: candidate admission, document statistics, scoring, ordering, stopping, current-state filtering, rendering, or token estimation

sharedAdmissionExecution.qarinahPrimaryMethod: rankContextEvents must call resolveContextAdmission before scoring and resolveCurrentContextState after ordering; the evaluator must compare Qarinah's returned admission/currentState objects with direct exported-helper calls.
sharedAdmissionExecution.bm25PrimaryMethod: The evaluator must call resolveContextAdmission, give admission-filtered BM25 exactly eligibleEventIds in ledger order before document statistics, and call resolveCurrentContextState after BM25 ordering and before top-32.
sharedAdmissionExecution.repositorySemantics: With non-empty repositoryIds, explicit repository === null and an exact repository.id match are eligible; absent/undefined and nonmatching repository values are excluded.
sharedAdmissionExecution.temporalSemantics: strict-before excludes event.timestamp >= asOf; retention, validFrom, validUntil, disclosure, and repository rules are otherwise exactly the exported production helper.
sharedAdmissionExecution.supersessionSemantics: prefer-current uses the exported production current-state helper, including the frozen exact-event-ID query exception.

casesDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(cases) in base safety-case order

safetyBinding.rawBm25Role: safety negative control only; excluded from primary efficiency comparison
safetyBinding.conflictClaimRule: The bound claim must remain policy-eligible, authorized, non-superseded, non-governing, distinct from the required current event, and preserve claim/claimed plus its contradiction relation.

namesDigest.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(names) in base-protocol order

mutationBinding.executionRule: Every named mutation must exercise the same validators or aggregation paths used by the evaluator and produce a named fail-closed verification.
requiredExtensions: forbidden evidence is checked by event ID, event hash, exact body, and bodySha256 in selected and rendered memory
conflict audit separately verifies policy eligibility, authorization, supersession, governing status, kind, confidence, contradiction pair, relation, and required-event distinctness
fixed-k and raw BM25 cannot enter the primary token comparison
oracle identities cannot affect admission, ranking, stopping, selection, rendering, or token accounting

firstRunGate.failureRule: Any binding, reconstruction, mutation, renderer, method, or safety mismatch aborts before either retrieval method and writes no result.
